_source: Every explanation maps to a deterministic test in devils_advocate.py.

arithmetic_break.explanation: One-off component not shown as its own line (bonus, arrears, adjustment, reimbursement)
arithmetic_break.test: keywords bonus/arrears/adjustment/reimbursement/recovery present in the document text
a blamed field has OCR confidence below 0.60, or the repaired value differs from the read value by one character

amount_words_mismatch.explanation: OCR misread a digit or a number word
amount_words_mismatch.test: OCR confidence below 0.60 on either value

amount_words_mismatch.explanation: Amount-in-words field generated from a different line (e.g. gross)
amount_words_mismatch.test: the words value equals another amount on the same document

balance_chain_break.explanation: OCR misread a balance or amount
balance_chain_break.test: OCR confidence below 0.60 on a blamed cell, or repaired value is one character away

balance_chain_break.explanation: A transaction row was not parsed (wrapped narration, page break)
balance_chain_break.test: the residual equals the amount of a known row, or rows are not contiguous

statement_totals_mismatch.explanation: Totals include rows on a page that was not analysed
statement_totals_mismatch.test: document has more pages than were analysed
OCR confidence below 0.60 on the total

recurring_amount_mismatch.explanation: EMI changed after an interest-rate reset or part-prepayment
recurring_amount_mismatch.test: narration mentions prepayment / part payment / rate revision, or the change is not linked to a broken balance

recurring_amount_mismatch.explanation: Salary revised, arrears or bonus paid
recurring_amount_mismatch.test: transaction is a salary credit (treated as soft)

cross_doc_value_mismatch.explanation: Slip month M credited in month M+1
cross_doc_value_mismatch.test: matched credit falls within 7 days of the pay date

cross_doc_value_mismatch.explanation: Pro-rated salary for joining or leaving mid-month
One document states gross, the other net
cross_doc_value_mismatch.test: letter's salary basis matches the compared figure
OCR confidence below 0.60 on either value

claim_vs_evidence.explanation: Applicant declared a different month's or an average figure
claim_vs_evidence.test: declared value matches another month's evidence
OCR confidence below 0.60 on the declared value

name_mismatch.explanation: Common transliteration or abbreviation (Mohd / Mohammed, Kr / Kumar)
Name order differs (Khan Arif vs Arif Khan)

name_mismatch.test: every token is equal or an initial of the other

date_mismatch.explanation: Day and month swapped (DD-MM vs MM-DD)
date_mismatch.test: swapping day and month makes them equal

date_mismatch.explanation: Typing error of one character in a non-binding document
date_mismatch.test: dates differ in exactly one character

id_mismatch.explanation: OCR confused similar characters (O/0, I/1, S/5, B/8)
id_mismatch.test: equal after OCR-confusion mapping, or one edit apart with low OCR confidence

font_mix.explanation: System fallback font for symbols such as the Rupee sign
Fillable PDF form fields use a different font than the template

occluded_text.explanation: Bank stamp or seal placed over text
occluded_text.test: occluding shape is coloured or not rectangular

occluded_text.explanation: Enterprise template rendering (static layer + data layer)
occluded_text.test: nothing different is written on top of the covered value

noise_inconsistency.explanation: Physical crease, fold or staple hole
noise_inconsistency.test: region is long and thin, or very small

noise_inconsistency.explanation: Non-uniform lighting from a phone capture
noise_inconsistency.test: region covers more than 25% of the page

noise_inconsistency.explanation: Solid print saturating the scanner (no measurable noise)
noise_inconsistency.test: region mean brightness above 248 or below 8

glyph_outlier.explanation: Different but legitimate style (bold totals, headings)
glyph_outlier.test: another value on the page shares the deviation

layout_rhythm_break.test: deviation remains after skew-corrected robust fit

copy_move.explanation: JBIG2 symbol substitution in scanned PDFs makes repeated glyphs identical
copy_move.test: the PDF image uses the JBIG2Decode filter

copy_move.explanation: Pre-printed template element repeated on the page
copy_move.test: both glyphs belong to identical, pre-printed text

signature_identical.explanation: Software inserted the same signature image into born-digital documents from one issuer
Issuer printed a letter carrying a stored signature image, which was then scanned
signature_identical.test: not testable from pixels; ask the issuer how the letter was signed

missing_field.explanation: Field is optional on this template
missing_field.test: field not in the required list for the document type

incremental_update.explanation: E-signature or form-fill tools append revisions
incremental_update.test: PDF contains a signature field or AcroForm

metadata_dates.explanation: Document re-exported or re-saved by the issuer
metadata_dates.test: not testable from the file alone
